image.name: rpcs3
image.description: [RPCS3](https://rpcs3.net/) is a multi-platform open-source Sony PlayStation 3 emulator and debugger written in C++ for Windows, Linux, macOS and FreeBSD.

changelog.desc: Start ingesting head appimage again, add notes on using SDL for controller support.
Pin back to latest v0.0.37 build to function, make Wayland default disable with PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=false.

volumes.desc: Users home directory in the container, stores local files and settings

ports.desc: HTTP RPCS3 desktop gui must be proxied.

custom.name: shm-size
custom.desc: This is needed for RPCS3 to function.

image.title: Rpcs3
image.setup_instructions:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/

**Note: for gamepads to function select SDL as the gamepad driver under "Handlers".**

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  rpcs3:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/rpcs3:latest
    container_name: rpcs3
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    volumes:
      - /path/to/config:/config
    ports:
      - 3000:3000
      - 3001:3001
    shm_size: "1gb"
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=rpcs3 \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -p 3001:3001 \
  -v /path/to/config:/config \
  --shm-size="1gb" \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/rpcs3:latest
